items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: I have a tenor player with me now, Lucious Washington

ctx.x: Right, Johnny Griffin and Gene Ammons.

This is why the influence -- I have a tenor player with me now, Lucious Washington, and everybody that hears him for the first time,they hear the influence of Jug in him. Because so many of the guys -- there's another guy around here named Prince James, I don't know whether you know him.
